ideas.pitch: An AI-powered platform tailored for Indian retail borrowers that automates credit underwriting and document verification to deliver branch-like banking experiences digitally.
ideas.title: LoanSphere AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of CapitalCue at the Standard Chartered Hackathon by directly solving everyday financial access challenges for middle-class consumers.

ideas.pitch: A graph-intelligence-based AML risk detection platform designed for small-scale fintech lenders in India to flag fraudulent UPI transactions and suspicious cash flows.
ideas.title: MicroGuard AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced graph intelligence and explainable machine learning, a proven winning formula from the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A self-custodial virtual credit card backed by decentralized identity verification for Indian freelancers receiving global crypto payments.
ideas.title: CryptoCard India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the cross-border payment utility gap in India using self-custodial decentralized payment patterns that won ETHLisbon.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace facilitating automated micro-task payouts and service settlements via stablecoin escrow.
ideas.title: AgentPay Bazaar
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the winning autonomous agent marketplace pattern from the Synthesis Hackathon into a scalable B2B gig-economy tool.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven options strategy simulator and hedging assistant for retail investors entering the Indian derivatives market.
ideas.title: RiskShield Options
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the AI X Options prize-winning architecture seen at the MUBA Hackathon by combining derivative safety with predictive AI.
